classDiagram
    class Task {
        int id
        string title
        string description
        TaskState state
        datetime createdAt
        datetime updatedAt
        datetime finishedAt
        string completionMemo
        datetime confirmedAt
        string confirmCommitId
    }

    class TaskDesignSpecificationLink {
        int taskId
        string designExternalId
        string targetType
        string displayName
        int sortOrder
    }

    class TaskFileChange {
        int taskId
        FileChangeKind kind
        string path
    }

    class QaAttachment {
        int taskId
        int qaCheckId
    }

    class TaskState {
        open
        finished
        confirmed
    }

    class FileChangeKind {
        created
        changed
    }

    Task --> TaskState
    Task --> TaskDesignSpecificationLink
    Task --> TaskFileChange
    Task --> QaAttachment
    TaskFileChange --> FileChangeKind
